content:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: we agreed to a focused alert-tuning sprint to cut paging noise by 60%. Posting owners + quick plan.
aj: 👍 can you drop the list here?
maria: Sure — short plan below, please react with blockers.

```
Sprint plan (owner / due):
- Audit low-value alerts -> archive or lower-priority (owner: @kevin) / due: 2026-04-02
- Implement fingerprint-based dedupe + suppression lists (owner: @tara) / due: 2026-03-28
- Auto-threshold tuning for distribution-skewed metrics (owner: @aj) / due: 2026-03-27
- Update paging policy: add quiet windows, tiered escalations (owner: @maria) / due: 2026-03-31
- Correlate recurring incidents into families, push to RCA board (owner: @mike) / due: 2026-04-06
- Smoke tests + rollback playbooks for any paging changes (owner: @ops) / due: before deploy
```

mike: I'll take pattern correlation. Need alert history export (90d) + incident tags. Can ops grant access?
ops: Granted `alerts-history-read` to mike and kevin for 10 days. I'll attach export instructions in the ticket.
sre-alert-bot: Alert export job queued: job-id=AE-20260315-72. ETA ~15m
kevin: For archival, I'll prepare a whitelist/blacklist approach. Archive if owner-ack=false and mean-time-to-user-impact < 2% over 90d.
aj: For auto-tune, I'll run a candidate pass with boxcox-normalization + p50/p95 hysteresis. Will post results to the PR.
tara: Dedupe approach: group by `alert_signature = hash(metric, cluster, rule_id)` then apply suppression windows for churny sources. Will create proto rules in `eng-oncall/alerting` repo.
maria: Remember to include change logs in PRs and a one-line summary for support headcount planning.
kevin: Quick Q: do we prefer scheduled suppressions during maintenance windows or soft-silence flags?
maria: Prefer scheduled suppressions (keeps history) unless data loss is a concern.
ops: I'll coordinate maintenance windows and add a CI smoke-test job that runs post-change to verify paging routes.
aj: Adding rollback: PRs should include a single-button revert script and a smoke checklist (endpoints, synthetic user flow, alerting heartbeat).
mike: I'll tag recurring families by symptom tags and push to the RCA board: https://redwood.pm/rca/alerts-families
sre-alert-bot: Runbook update required: RB-501 created for paging policy doc changes.
tara: I'll open the dedupe PR and add test cases: simulated duplicate bursts + expected single page. Reviewers: @maria @aj
kevin: Archival PR will include an automated job to rehydrate rules if false-positive archive >5% in 14d.
maria: Weekly sync proposal: Wednesdays 11:00 PT for 30m until sprint end. Ack?
aj: ack
kevin: ack
mike: ack
ops: ack
maria: If anyone hits blockers before EOD Tue, ping me so we can reassign. Closing thread — keep Asana tasks updated: https://app.asana.com/0/987654321/board
